miskonsepsi_kali_negatif.label: Negative times negative
miskonsepsi_kali_negatif.description: Believes a negative times a negative stays negative.

miskonsepsi_tertukar_operasi.label: Swapped operation
miskonsepsi_tertukar_operasi.description: Uses the wrong operation, e.g. adds instead of multiplies.

miskonsepsi_urutan_operasi.label: Order of operations
miskonsepsi_urutan_operasi.description: Ignores the order of operations, e.g. adds before multiplying or works strictly left to right.

miskonsepsi_tanda_pengurangan.label: Subtracting a negative
miskonsepsi_tanda_pengurangan.description: Treats subtracting a negative number as subtracting a positive one, e.g. 5 - (-3) = 2.

miskonsepsi_gabung_koefisien.label: Adding coefficients wrongly
miskonsepsi_gabung_koefisien.description: Adds the coefficients of like terms incorrectly.

miskonsepsi_gabung_suku_tidak_sejenis.label: Combining unlike terms
miskonsepsi_gabung_suku_tidak_sejenis.description: Combines terms that are not like terms, e.g. 2x + 3 = 5x.

miskonsepsi_substitusi_salah.label: Wrong substitution
miskonsepsi_substitusi_salah.description: Substitutes a value incorrectly or mixes up the order of operations.

miskonsepsi_distribusi.label: Distribution errors
miskonsepsi_distribusi.description: Distributes a factor or a minus sign to only the first term inside brackets.

miskonsepsi_pindah_ruas.label: Moving terms across '='
miskonsepsi_pindah_ruas.description: Keeps the same sign when moving a term to the other side of an equation.

miskonsepsi_kuadrat_jumlah.label: Squaring a sum
miskonsepsi_kuadrat_jumlah.description: Expands (a+b)^2 as a^2+b^2 and drops the middle term.

miskonsepsi_coret_salah.label: Cancelling terms, not factors
miskonsepsi_coret_salah.description: Cancels individual terms across a fraction instead of common factors.

miskonsepsi_faktor_persekutuan.label: Common factor
miskonsepsi_faktor_persekutuan.description: Misses or mishandles a common factor when factoring.

miskonsepsi_lupa_ruas_nol.label: Equation not set to zero
miskonsepsi_lupa_ruas_nol.description: Applies the zero-product rule without first moving everything to one side.

miskonsepsi_selisih_kuadrat.label: Difference of squares
miskonsepsi_selisih_kuadrat.description: Does not recognise a^2 - b^2 = (a-b)(a+b) and tries another method.

miskonsepsi_pemilihan_faktor.label: Wrong factor pair
miskonsepsi_pemilihan_faktor.description: Picks numbers that do not satisfy both the product and the sum conditions.

miskonsepsi_tanda_negatif.label: Sign errors
miskonsepsi_tanda_negatif.description: Finds the right numbers but gets the plus/minus signs wrong.

miskonsepsi_tidak_paham_faktorisasi.label: Not a product
miskonsepsi_tidak_paham_faktorisasi.description: Gives an answer that is not a product of factors; does not see factoring as the reverse of multiplying.

miskonsepsi_tidak_paham_konsep_akar.label: Only one root
miskonsepsi_tidak_paham_konsep_akar.description: Does not realise a quadratic can have two roots and gives only one.

miskonsepsi_rumus_abc.label: Quadratic formula slips
miskonsepsi_rumus_abc.description: Makes sign or division errors in the quadratic formula.

miskonsepsi_lupa_konstanta.label: Forgotten constant
miskonsepsi_lupa_konstanta.description: Forgets to add or subtract the constant after multiplying.

miskonsepsi_komposisi_fungsi.label: Composition order
miskonsepsi_komposisi_fungsi.description: Applies functions in the wrong order or multiplies them instead of composing.

miskonsepsi_substitusi_langsung.label: Direct substitution on 0/0
miskonsepsi_substitusi_langsung.description: Substitutes the limit value directly and does not notice a 0/0 form.

miskonsepsi_bentuk_tak_tentu.label: Indeterminate form
miskonsepsi_bentuk_tak_tentu.description: Does not know how to handle 0/0 and answers 'undefined'.

miskonsepsi_sin_nol.label: Sine limit at zero
miskonsepsi_sin_nol.description: Treats sin(x)/x as 0 or 'undefined' at x -> 0 instead of using the standard limit sin(x)/x = 1.

miskonsepsi_koef_trig.label: Coefficient in trig limit
miskonsepsi_koef_trig.description: Gets the constant wrong in lim sin(ax)/(bx), e.g. answers a*b or b/a instead of a/b.

miskonsepsi_cos_limit.label: Cosine limit
miskonsepsi_cos_limit.description: Misapplies (1 - cos x)/x^2 as x -> 0, e.g. answers 1 or 0 instead of 1/2.

miskonsepsi_identitas_trig.label: Trig identity slip
miskonsepsi_identitas_trig.description: Uses a trigonometric identity incorrectly, e.g. sin 2x = 2 sin x or cos^2 x = 1 - sin x.
